title.en: Dedicated neighborhood pet and bird destination

text.en: Local shoppers appreciate this neighborhood pet store on 47th Street for its focus on birds, cages, and everyday pet care products. Visitors note that the shop reliably stocks essential supplies that can be difficult to find at chain retailers, making it a convenient local resource for pet owners across the New City community.

Reviewers frequently praise the store associates for their courteous service and detailed guidance regarding bird care. Customers highlight that staff members take time to answer care questions thoroughly, assist with selecting proper companion birds, and provide helpful advice for first-time bird owners and experienced keepers alike.

Pet parents highlight their satisfaction with purchasing companion birds, specifically mentioning lively cockatiels and sweet Bourke parrots. Buyers note that the birds are energetic, playful, and adjust well to new homes, describing their newly adopted birds as affectionate additions to their household aviaries.

q.en: Does Paradise De Aves Pet Shop sell live birds?

a.en: Yes, the shop specializes in companion birds including cockatiels, parrots, and parakeets.

q.en: Can staff members answer questions about bird care?

a.en: Yes, customers report that the team is knowledgeable, friendly, and answers questions about bird diet and housing.

q.en: Does the shop carry cages and bird food?

a.en: Yes, the store provides cages, bird feed, and everyday care accessories alongside live companion birds.

q.en: How are prices compared to other pet stores?

a.en: Reviewers note that prices for birds and supplies are fair and competitive compared to larger chain retailers.
